policy.performance: Only reproducible artifact signals are controlled ceilings. Web build bytes and Mobile non-runtime asset bytes must not grow without an explicit reviewed baseline update. Raw Hermes bytecode size is observed but not enforced because repeat builds of unchanged app source showed one-byte variance.
policy.accessibility: Deterministic issue counts are controlled per-route/per-rule ceilings. The public-route baseline is zero after remediation; any new deterministic issue fails.
policy.runtime_timing: Observed for diagnostics only. No timing threshold is enforced until a repeatable benchmark environment and variance study exist.
policy.certification_boundary: This baseline is a regression-control artifact. It is not physical-device performance evidence, WCAG certification, store approval or market-release certification.

non_enforced_observations.repeatability_note: On unchanged mobile application source, a subsequent exact-head export observed Android Hermes bytecode +1 byte and iOS Hermes bytecode -1 byte. These raw bytecode lengths therefore remain diagnostic until a deterministic runtime-code measurement is established.

runtime_resource_budget.policy: Capture encoded total/JS/CSS resource bytes per controlled public route on the exact PR head. Freeze the measured values only after the capture is reviewed; wall-clock timings remain informational.
